correctness.rationale: The suffix restriction at the smallest shattered vertex proves the universal VC upper bound by induction, while disjoint induced edges give its matching lower bound. The complete depth-four tree has 16 distinct independent-dominating realizers and is checked against direct exhaustive enumeration. The 10-vertex count gives the online upper bound and the all-smaller-orders count forces equality with VC. The separator embedding preserves independence and domination for every tuple of blocks, giving the unbounded connected-path gap.

originality.rationale: The closest identified general maximal-independent-set result, Liu et al. 2024 Lemma 2.20, supplies only an upper bound by bipartite induced matchings; on P10 that bound permits four, whereas the proved static dimension is three. It neither supplies a four-level online witness nor implies the connected-path linear separation. The online/stability literature and random-greedy path literature address distinct implications. Direct and alias searches found no stronger coverage in the inspected sources; novelty remains subject to historical discovery.
